I answered Dana in a thread on their #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is **ticket #4092**.

- **Source:** Ilse Varga posted it in #north-random on Oct 13, saying IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. Dana is a member of #north-random, so this is something they could already see. I also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.
- **Left out:** Earlier in their direct message with me, Dana guessed the ticket would end up as OPS-5546 next year and asked me to keep that private. I didn't mention it in the channel. It was a guess, not a real ticket number.
